leadText: Pocket Monsters BW: The Heroes of Fire and Thunder (Japanese: ポケットモンスターB・W　炎雷の英雄) is a Pokémon manga that was serialized in CoroCoro Special between February and October 2011. It is illustrated and written by Satoshi Kanda.
